stemMd: For what k is x−1 a factor of x cubed+kx−4?
explanationMd: A factor x−1 requires P(1)=0. Thus 1+k−4=0 and k=3. This is the factor theorem applied to the specified root.

distractorRationale.c: This reverses the sign in the root condition.
distractorRationale.a: This does not make the polynomial vanish.
distractorRationale.d: This omits the x cubed contribution at x=1.
